result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly. One notable defect: the 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile which all have icons. No other visually broken elements found.

issues.description: The 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar has no icon, while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons. This makes the nav bar look inconsistent and the Orders label appears to float mid-bar.
issues.suggestion: Add an icon (e.g., a receipt or clipboard glyph) for the Orders tab, vertically centered like the other nav icons
